title: Automated HTP copolymerisation of BMA-BA in 48-well reactor with t0/t1 NMR sampling (20-variant design, 2 h, repeats)
goal: Generate f10-X-F1 data at varied feed ratios and AIBN levels for reactivity ratio estimation of BMA-BA, and check reproducibility across days with re-randomised wells.

title: BMA-BA reaction time and dataset size controls (30 min vs 2 h; 45-point extended f10 range; combined datasets)
goal: Show that varying AIBN concentration rather than time gives consistent reactivity ratios, and assess how the number of datapoints and f10 range affect the confidence interval.
